d: TalentScript is recruiting a Senior Investment Accountant for a Kuwait-based holding company. You’ll join a small finance team and personally handle investment accounting across several group entities, from recording transactions to reporting them in the financial statements.
q: At least four years of accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for recording and reconciling investment transactions .
A bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance and a completed CA, CPA, ACCA or CMA qualification.
Practical IFRS and multi-entity accounting experience. Microsoft Dynamics experience is a plus.
r: Record investment purchases, disposals, dividend income and related gains or losses.
Reconcile investment balances against supporting statements and investigate differences before month-end close.
Prepare IFRS financial statements for assigned entities and support intercompany reconciliations and group consolidation.
Prepare investment schedules for external auditors and respond to audit queries.
